paragraphs: Karna. ‘The judges of the exile’ (see there). He took payment to judge: Ketubbot 105a. Rav cursed him for testing him with three questions, that a horn should grow in his eyes: Shabbat 108a. Shmuel told him that a horn should grow between his eyes: Bava Batra 89a. Rashbam suggests that Rav's and Shmuel's curses together caused a horn to grow; another version does not read ‘a horn grew,’ because that did not happen. He said concerning Shmuel's words, ‘There is something behind this.’ He was told, “Let us send to Mar Ukva,” and they sent the question to Rav (Kiddushin 44b:6–7). [The Bavli has a collective reply pointing to Mar Ukva and his court in Kafri.] Rav Idi bar Avin, the carpenter, taught in Nezikin of the school of Karna: Sanhedrin 30b. R' Yehudah bar R' Simon taught in Nezikin of the school of Karna: Bava Kamma 47b. He was Shmuel's colleague.
